noeuds.role: Puts the object directly at position X, Y (teleport).
noeuds.exemple: put the player back at the start.

noeuds.role: Moves the object by the given distance from where it is now. A physics object is stopped by walls.
noeuds.exemple: linked to “Object Held Down”: “Add X” = 5 moves right.

noeuds.role: Changes an object property chosen from a list (x, y, rotation, opacity, text…).
noeuds.exemple: set the rotation of a clock hand to =temps * 90.

noeuds.role: Turns the object to the given angle, in degrees.
noeuds.exemple: =wheel.rotation + 5 linked to “Every frame” keeps the object “wheel” spinning.

noeuds.role: Sets the object's transparency: 0 = invisible, 1 = solid.
noeuds.exemple: 0.5 for a half-transparent ghost.

noeuds.role: Shows (true) or hides (false) the object.
noeuds.exemple: show a “You win!” message hidden at the start.

noeuds.role: Gives the object a new tag (label).
noeuds.exemple: a defeated enemy gets the tag “harmless”.

noeuds.role: Changes the object's layer: the bigger the number, the more the object is in front of others.
noeuds.exemple: put the player in front of a decoration.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Horizontal size (1 = normal), Vertical size (1 = normal)
noeuds.role: Changes the object's size: 1 = normal, 2 = twice as big, 0.5 = half.
noeuds.exemple: the player grows after eating a mushroom.

noeuds.role: Removes the chosen object from the scene.
noeuds.exemple: choose “Implied Object” to destroy the coin the player just touched.

noeuds.role: Removes all objects with this tag.
noeuds.exemple: a bomb destroys every “Enemy” object.

noeuds.role: Replaces the object's image with another image from the Assets. Empty = no image.
noeuds.exemple: the character looks left or right depending on the button.

noeuds.role: Changes the object's color.
noeuds.exemple: a button turns green when the answer is right.

noeuds.role: Creates a copy of object B (the model) at the place of object A (the spawn point).
noeuds.exemple: a cannon (A) that spawns cannonballs (B).

noeuds.role: Applies a filter to the object: Black and White, Sepia, Invert, or None to remove it.
noeuds.exemple: switch to black and white during a flashback.

noeuds.role: Changes how the object blends with what is behind it (Additive, Multiply, Screen, Invert).
noeuds.exemple: Additive for a glowing light or flame.

noeuds.role: Flips the object: Horizontal (left / right) or Vertical (up / down).
noeuds.exemple: the character faces the way it walks.

noeuds.role: Locks or unlocks the object in the editor (the padlock). It has no effect during the game: to stop an object from being dragged, use “Set draggable”.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Background speed (1 = normal, 0.5 = slower, far away effect)
noeuds.role: Sets how fast the object scrolls when the camera moves: 1 = normal, 0.5 = half as fast (depth effect).
noeuds.exemple: mountains in the background that scroll slowly.

noeuds.role: Attaches object A (the child) to object B (the parent): A follows B when it moves.
noeuds.exemple: a sword that follows the character's hand.

noeuds.role: Surrounds the object with a soft glow of the chosen color and size (it follows the shape of images), or removes it.
noeuds.exemple: a bonus that glows yellow, size 20.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Preset, Count (0 = preset's), Color (empty = preset's), Size (1 = normal), Image (empty = preset shapes)
noeuds.role: Fires a burst of particles on the object: explosion, sparks, dust, smoke, fire, rain, snow, confetti, trail, wake trail, hyperspace or speed lines. Count, color and size can be set. With an image ("Image" setting), each particle becomes that image: a drawn explosion, a star, a leaf…
noeuds.exemple: a hit enemy explodes in magenta: Explosion preset, color #FF40D0.

noeuds.role: Turns a “Particles” object on or off: it emits continuously or stops (particles already fired finish their life).
noeuds.exemple: turn the engine exhaust on when the ship moves.

noeuds.role: Fires many particles at once from a “Particles” object, with its settings (preset, color, size).
noeuds.exemple: 80 confetti when the level is won.

noeuds.role: Changes the preset of a “Particles” object during the game.
noeuds.exemple: a fire that turns into smoke when it is put out.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, State, Speed (milliseconds, 1000 = 1 s), Duration (milliseconds, 0 = endless)
noeuds.role: Makes the object blink at the chosen speed (ms), for a duration (ms, 0 = forever), or stops the blinking.
noeuds.exemple: the player blinks for 1 second after being hit.

noeuds.nom: Create a copy of the object
noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object B, X position, Y position
noeuds.role: Creates a copy of object B (the model) at position X, Y. The copy becomes the “Implied Object”.
noeuds.exemple: drop a rock at a random position: X = random(0, 800).

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object A, Object B, Model name, Direction, Speed, Destroy off screen (yes / no)
noeuds.role: Creates a projectile (the object named in “Model name”) at object A, and launches it at the chosen speed: 0°, 90°, 180°, 270°, towards object B (“Toward target”) or along A's angle.
noeuds.exemple: a ship firing lasers upwards (270).

noeuds.role: Sets how full a progress bar is, between its minimum and maximum.
noeuds.exemple: “New progress” = vie (health), for a health bar.

noeuds.role: Whatever leaves one side of the screen comes back on the opposite side (Pac-Man effect).
noeuds.exemple: an asteroid that leaves on the right and comes back on the left.

noeuds.role: Stops the object from leaving the screen. The margin stops it a little before the edge.
noeuds.exemple: the player's ship always stays visible.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Lightning color, Duration (seconds, 0 = endless), Intensity (0 = stop, 1 to 3)
noeuds.role: Lightning crackles around the object: it flashes in the lightning color, shakes and throws sparks. Duration 0 = endless (electric fence); intensity 0 = stop.
noeuds.exemple: the wizard touches a trap: “Electrocution” on the wizard (1 second), “Wait” 1 second, then “Restart the scene”.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Preset, Color (empty = preset's), Size (1 = normal)
noeuds.role: The object leaves a trail of particles behind it when it moves (preset, color and size of your choice). Set on a shot's model, every shot inherits it. Preset “None” removes it.
noeuds.exemple: shots that leave a glowing trail: target = the shot's model, Trail preset.

noeuds.role: Creates a copy of the chosen object (the model) at position X, Y.
noeuds.exemple: add a crate at an exact spot.

noeuds.role: Smoothly changes the object's opacity to the target value, over the chosen time (seconds). The next nodes run without waiting.
noeuds.exemple: fade out a title in 1 second (target opacity 0).
